entities.summary: Peter Horn was a Danish fighter pilot. Horn was born on 15 October 1915. He joined the Danish Army and trained as a pilot, graduating as a qualified pilot in 1937. On 9 October 1938 he was made Sekondløjtnant and at the outbreak of war, was a Lieutenant in the reserve.
